author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಊಹೆಗೂ ನಿಲುಕದಿಹ ವಿಷಯಗಳು ಜರುಗುವವು
ದೇಹಮನ ಸೌಖ್ಯವಿರೆ ಎದುರಿಸಲು ಸುಲಭ
ನೇಹದಿಂದಲೆ ಬದುಕಿ ಶಾಂತತೆಯ ಗಳಿಸುತಿರೆ
ಗೇಹದಲಿ ಚೈತನ್ಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: if body and mind are well, they are easy to face;
if you live with affection and keep gaining calm,
there is life and energy in the home, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The unexpected will come. A healthy body and mind make it easier to meet. Living with love and calm fills a home with life.
